question: Why does FastAPI reject a Pydantic model as a path parameter?

options.a: Path segments are plain strings in the URL, so only scalar types can be parsed from them
options.b: Pydantic models can only be used with POST requests
options.c: FastAPI requires every model to have a default value before it can be used in a route
options.d: Path parameters are validated before the app starts, and models are not importable at that time

question: You build an endpoint that takes a large list of past answers and returns a recommendation, storing nothing. Which choice is best?

options.a: GET, because it stores nothing, so it must be GET
options.b: POST, because the large structured input belongs in the body, even though it has no side effects
options.c: GET, because POST requests cannot return data
options.d: POST, because GET requests cannot be used with JSON at all
